item.title: Washington passes "millionaires tax" despite concerns of wealth flight
item.description: Following a 24-hour marathon session, Washington lawmakers passed a 9.9% tax on high earners. Gov. Bob Ferguson calls it "historic progress" for working families.

item.title: FOX Business launches 'Made in America' small business contest with $25K cash prizes for winners
item.description: FOX Business launched a contest that awards $25,000 to three small businesses. Apply at SmallBusinessAwards2026.com with video or written entry submission.

item.title: Fuel crisis forces airlines to announce major fare increases, flight cancellations as Iran conflict escalates
item.description: U.S. flight prices could jump 11% as the Iran conflict drives oil costs and airlines worldwide are already hiking fares, with domestic carriers likely to follow.

item.title: Classic brand becoming a status symbol in Trump’s White House
item.description: President Donald Trump reportedly gifts Florsheim dress shoes to top officials, turning the 134-year-old brand into an unexpected White House status symbol.

item.title: Costco sued by customer seeking refunds for tariff payments
item.description: Costco is facing a proposed class action lawsuit from a customer seeking tariff refunds for higher prices after the Supreme Court ruled Trump tariffs unconstitutional.

item.title: Trump demands Powell cut rates as Iran conflict drives up energy prices
item.description: Trump pressures Fed Chair Jerome Powell to cut rates “immediately" ahead of the March 17 meeting, escalating tensions over the central bank’s independence.

item.title: Reno surpasses Las Vegas as top destination for California homebuyers seeking affordability
item.description: Reno attracts a surge of California homebuyers as Nevada's second-largest metro surpasses Las Vegas as the top destination for Golden State residents seeking affordability.

item.title: 'Zombie mall' to be razed for apartments as retail apocalypse drags on
item.description: New Jersey's struggling Raritan Mall faces potential redevelopment of a 276-unit apartment complex with retail space after years of decline.

item.title: LARRY KUDLOW: Is John F. Kennedy having a comeback?
item.description: Democratic senators surface plans that would end most income taxes for middle-class Americans

item.title: American farmers pinched by high diesel prices ahead of Spring planting season
item.description: Diesel prices continue to rise as many farmers prepare for the Spring planting season. Analysts expect prices to swell for several weeks, even after the Iran conflict ends.
